gloss: comprehensive medical checkup; thorough physical examination

definitions.gloss: comprehensive medical checkup; thorough physical examination
definitions.explanation: A comprehensive one-day or multi-day health examination that includes blood tests, imaging, internal organ checks, and other detailed screening. More thorough than a standard health checkup and typically paid for privately.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ (human) + ドック (dock), borrowing the nautical metaphor of a ship entering dry dock for thorough maintenance. A Japanese-coined term referring to a voluntary, comprehensive health checkup that goes well beyond the basic annual checkup. Not usually covered by public health insurance, though many employers and insurance plans subsidize it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人間|にんげん}ドック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to have a comprehensive medical checkup
- {人間|にんげん}ドック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: comprehensive checkup results
- {人間|にんげん}ドック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: comprehensive checkup reservation
- ⟦{一|いち}{日|にち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{人間|にんげん}ドック: one-day comprehensive checkup
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧{人間|にんげん}ドック: same-day (non-overnight) comprehensive checkup

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧: health checkup — the basic annual checkup, usually free through employers or municipalities
- {定期健診|ていきけんしん}: regular health checkup — routine, employer-provided
- ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧ドック: brain checkup — a specialized version focusing on the brain (using MRI/CT)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{人間|にんげん}ドックs are a distinctively Japanese institution and are associated with taking preventive care of one's health, especially from middle age onward. They are often considered a responsible "adult" habit.
